MISCELLANEOUS No.17423 of 2023
Arising Out of PS. Case No.-74 Year-2022 Thana- MAHILA P.S. Distr

======================================================
 SHIVANGI DEVI @ NANHI wife of Mahesh Sah RESIDENT OF  SHIVNAGAR JURAWANPUR BARARI PS- JURAWANPUR DISTRICT-  VAISHALI  ... 
 Versus  The State of Bihar Bihar  ... ... Opposite Party/s

=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Lakshmi Kant Sharma  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Madhuri Lata  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH
ORAL ORDER 2 19-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the State and the informant.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/307/379 and other ancillary sections of the Indian Penal Code, sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and section 27 of the Arms Act.
It is a case of torture and harassment for dowry.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is gotini of the victim.
Allegation of torture and harassment is general and omnibus and no overt act has been alleged against her.
Thrust of accusation is against the husband of the victim.
Petitioner is separate in mess and business.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.17423 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023
Learned counsel for the State as well as the informant oppose the prayer for bail.
Considering the aforesaid facts of the case, prayer for bail of all the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patna in Patna Mahila Police Shivangi Devi @ Nanhi vs The State Of Bihar on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155949248/
